TAL_WATER_FLOWING_STEP.why: Owned Return self-target and native granted movement; native turn-start environmental standing offer in water_return.
TAL_WATER_FLOWING_STEP.player_outcome: Return the Flow may move you up to 10 feet, even away from the selected Water effect. Soaked creatures and creatures in your Currents or Basins cannot make Opportunity Attacks against this move. Starting your turn in rain, mist, wet ground or your own Basin offers one stand without spending movement.
